description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Curl, which implements an HTTP client adapter using cURL for the Zend Framework. It manages HTTP requests, cURL options, connection handling, and response processing.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Curl
classes.description: An adapter class for Zend_Http_Client based on the curl extension, handling HTTP requests via cURL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that checks for the curl extension and initializes invalid cURL options.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the cURL adapter, including proxy settings.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initializes a cURL session and connects to a specified host and port.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified method, URI, headers, and body.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets a stream resource for output.

methods.name: readHeader
methods.description: Header callback function for cURL to read headers into response.
